title: Newhalo feature bento
description: A black product section: a 100px white heading that wipes in, a wide scene slot, then a bento of graphite cards with 8px corners and 2px gaps (two per row, some full width and taller). Each card has a 24px title, a short paragraph, a close-up slot in its lower part and a small white icon that sends out thin cobalt rings on a loop. Cards bloom in (1.1→1) and their text rises 30px.
notes: the rings use chart-4 (cobalt in this theme)
the scene slot held a 3D product with hotspots in the original
name: newhalo-product-features
